categories.main_business_segments: Lanjian Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the intelligent logistics systems sector, focusing on the research, design, production, sales, and service of smart logistics systems centered around intelligent robots. Their product portfolio includes warehouse robots, shuttle robots, handling robots, picking robots, loading/unloading robots, depalletizing robots, and aerial robots. They also provide RaaS (Robot as a Service) operation services, after-sales maintenance, and technical consulting and planning services, serving various industries such as aerospace, photovoltaics, new energy vehicles, tobacco, e-commerce, pharmaceuticals, and more.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary core technologies including advanced robotics, digital twin platforms, distributed ultra-low voltage DC servo conveyor systems, SLAM-based composite navigation, 3D vision-based recognition and positioning, multi-axis servo control, and dynamic scheduling algorithms for AGV fleets. They utilize modular and flexible production methods with a focus on customization, integrating hardware and software development, system integration, and digital simulation for optimized logistics solutions. Manufacturing involves multi-variety small-batch flexible production with assembly lines and point assembly processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lanjian serves a broad range of industries including aerospace, photovoltaics, new energy vehicles, tobacco, e-commerce, pharmaceuticals, automotive, petrochemical, electronics, and cold chain logistics. Their key customers include large enterprises in these sectors, with significant sales to top clients such as TianSong Construction Group, Fujian Tobacco Company, and BYD Co., Ltd. The company also targets emerging markets like military logistics, agricultural cold chain, and intelligent manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Jinan, Shandong Province, and has expanded its presence internationally with subsidiaries in Germany, the United States, and Hungary. They have actively developed overseas markets including Thailand, Mexico, Canada, Spain, Singapore, and Europe and America more broadly, achieving significant overseas project revenue growth and establishing a global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lanjian operates mainly in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain as a provider of integrated intelligent logistics solutions. They develop and manufacture core robotic equipment and software systems, integrate these into customized logistics solutions, and provide operation and maintenance services, positioning themselves as a system integrator and solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or end-user.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation with substantial R&D investment (10.56% of revenue in 2024), focusing on intelligent robotics, digital twin technology, AI integration, and advanced control systems. Key R&D projects include autonomous mobile robot fleets, ultra-high-density warehouse robots, digital twin logistics platforms, and flexible multi-industry adaptable solutions. They aim to lead in intelligent logistics technology, expand global market presence, and develop new industry applications such as smart manufacturing, medical health, and intelligent plant factories.
categories.revenue_model: Lanjian generates revenue primarily through direct sales of intelligent robot-based logistics systems, supplemented by RaaS (robotics as a service) operation fees, after-sales maintenance services, and technical consulting and planning services. The RaaS model includes guaranteed minimum storage and outbound volumes ensuring stable recurring income. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales with customized project-based contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lanjian is positioned as a leading domestic intelligent logistics system provider with strong self-developed core technologies and a comprehensive product chain covering hardware and software. While the global market is dominated by established players from Europe, Japan, and the US, Lanjian competes effectively in China with advantages in customization, cost-effectiveness, and service responsiveness. The company is recognized for its import substitution capability and growing international competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Lanjian achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.21 billion, a 23.8% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 112 million, up 1.48%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.95 billion, growing 20.26% from the previous year, with net assets of RMB 1.17 billion. Cash flow from operations improved significantly to RMB 215 million. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by increasing orders and expanding market reach.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lanjian emphasizes its unique value through comprehensive, highly customized intelligent logistics solutions integrating proprietary robotics hardware, advanced software including digital twin platforms, and full lifecycle services. Their products offer high flexibility, scalability, and efficiency improvements, enabling clients to achieve cost reduction and operational optimization. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive project experience, and integrated product chain provide competitive differentiation in meeting diverse industry needs with innovative, reliable, and intelligent logistics automation.
